page.title: Storage & Lifecycle
page.desc: Configure edge media storage backends (LocalFS, MinIO, or S3-compatible object storage), statfs watermark monitoring, local spooling, and hysteresis automated cleanup.

backend.label: Storage Backend Provider
backend.local_desc: Store media directly on local disks or external block mounts.
backend.s3_desc: Store recordings, snapshots, face templates, and maps in MinIO, AWS S3, Alibaba OSS, or Tencent COS.

form.title: Media Storage Path & Retention Policies
form.media_directory_desc: Root path for video streams, snapshots, and exports. When changed, new recordings write to the new location while historical recordings remain playable.
form.empty_path: Please specify a directory path first
form.test_success: Path validation passed with full read/write capabilities!
form.test_failed: Directory does not exist or lacks write permissions
form.path_valid: Directory valid with active read/write permissions
form.recordings_days_desc: Regular video recordings retention period (Default: 15 days)
form.snapshots_days_desc: AI snapshot maximum retention (Default: 90 days). Under capacity pressure, unlocked snapshots may be reclaimed earlier; alarm/locked evidence is excluded.
form.exports_hours_desc: Exported clips TTL survival time (Default: 48 hours)
form.mediaDirectoryPlaceholder: Absolute media root path, e.g. /mnt/storage/media or data/media

s3.secret_saved_placeholder: Saved — leave blank to keep existing key
s3.secret_saved_hint: A secret key is already encrypted on this host. Leave empty to keep it unchanged.
s3.use_path_style_desc: Required by most MinIO and self-hosted S3 deployments.
s3.use_tls_desc: Derived automatically from http:// or https:// endpoint scheme.
s3.insecure_skip_verify_desc: Only enable for self-signed certificates in isolated LANs.
s3.delivery_proxy_desc: Media bytes flow through the Zhulong host with existing cookie auth and HTTP Range support. No bucket CORS needed.
s3.delivery_redirect_desc: Redirect clients to short-lived presigned object URLs. Requires client reachability to S3, HTTPS alignment, and bucket CORS rules.
s3.local_fallback_desc: Fall back to local media directory when an unmigrated object misses in S3.
s3.spool_directory_desc: Temporary local staging directory before event clips are uploaded to S3.
s3.quota_gb_desc: Set 0 to enforce retention TTL only, or >0 to cap indexed remote storage.
s3.conn_success: S3 / MinIO connection and write check passed!
s3.conn_failed: Failed to connect or write to S3 bucket

migration.title: Historical Media Asset Migration
migration.desc: Copy existing local snapshots, recordings, face templates, and floor maps into the active S3 bucket and switch their metadata records.
migration.delete_local: Delete local source files after verified upload
migration.delete_local_desc: Keep disabled while testing to preserve local fallback copies.

advanced.title: Advanced Watermark & Emergency Stop Policies
advanced.high_watermark_desc: Pruning activates when disk usage reaches this percentage (Default: 90%)
advanced.low_watermark_desc: Pruning stops and cleaner sleeps when usage falls below this level (Default: 80%)
advanced.emergency_percent_desc: Forcibly stops new video recordings to protect SQLite and OS integrity (Default: 95%)
advanced.emergency_mb_desc: Writing suspended when available space falls below this margin (Default: 2048 MB)

dialog.title: Trigger Storage Prune Cycle
dialog.desc1: The system will first prune all expired exports, recordings, and snapshots, then evict the oldest unexpired recordings and unlocked snapshots while capacity pressure remains, until below the low watermark.
dialog.desc2: Recordings and snapshots marked with AI alarms or locked by users will never be deleted prematurely. Throttled sleep ensures 0 dropped frames.

validation.endpointRequired: Please enter an S3 / MinIO endpoint
validation.endpointInvalid: Endpoint must be host[:port] or http(s)://host[:port] without path or query
validation.bucketRequired: Please enter an S3 bucket name
validation.accessKeyRequired: Please enter an S3 access key ID
validation.secretKeyRequired: Please enter a secret access key when configuring S3 for the first time
validation.spoolDirectoryRequired: Please enter a local spool directory
validation.spoolMaxMin: Spool cap must be at least 128 MB
validation.daysMin: Retention must be at least 1 day
validation.hoursMin: Retention must be at least 1 hour

validation.lowMin: Low watermark must be at least 40%

validation.emergencyAboveHigh: Emergency stop threshold cannot be below the high watermark
